{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify the rows with sentinel values (e.g., 0, -1, -999)
sentinel_mask = df['biomarker_baseline'].isin([0, -1, -999])
sentinel_rows = df[sentinel_mask]

# Check the distribution of sentinel values
print('Sentinel value counts:')
print(df['biomarker_baseline'].value_counts().loc[[0, -1, -999]])

# Remove sentinel values and compute the mean baseline biomarker value
valid_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'].loc[~sentinel_mask]
mean_valid_baseline = valid_baseline.mean()
print(f'Valid mean baseline biomarker value: {mean_valid_baseline}')"}
